title: A1 external adjudication constitution

roles.name: independence_adjudicator
roles.function: Determine identity, legal-entity separation, funding, relationships, contribution history, selection integrity, and conflicts without deciding technical evidence sufficiency.

roles.name: evidence_adjudicator
roles.function: Inspect exact-reference custody, command chronology, logs, failures, output fingerprints, signatures, and reproducibility without deciding the reproducer’s institutional independence.

roles.name: challenge_reviewer
roles.function: Review timely public challenges and require a new transaction when a material challenge, dissent, or contradiction remains unresolved.

roles.name: registry_custodian
roles.function: Verify mechanical transaction completeness and append the approved entry without changing substantive findings or suppressing history.

roles.name: public_observer
roles.function: Inspect the docket, selection record, decisions, challenges, blockers, registry history, and later revocation or expiry.

human_review_flags: employment, contract, funding, investment, governance, family, or close professional relationship within the prior three years
public advocacy or litigation position materially tied to the outcome
selection pool controlled or materially funded by a disqualified party
reviewer access mediated by the reproducer or project rather than the public evidence bundle
selective evidence, unexplained retries, unavailable raw logs, or denominator suppression
signature authority or identity not independently verifiable
dissent, challenge, or contradictory source not preserved in the docket
separation_rules: independence and evidence adjudicators must be different people and different legal entities
neither substantive adjudicator may be the reproducer, receipt preparer, project maintainer, reference contributor, vendor, operator, customer, adopter, or project-controlled bot
reviewers must be drawn from a public pool snapshot through a recorded method not controlled solely by a disqualified party
the registry custodian may be a maintainer only in a ministerial role and may not alter dispositions, blockers, dissent, challenges, evidence references, or signatures
a material challenge or dissent requires a new transaction or a separately constituted challenge review; the original transaction cannot silently overwrite it

all decisions, eligibility receipts, selection records, and challenges expire or remain subject to re-review when evidence disappears, identity changes, conflicts emerge, or the reference capsule changes
